name: L2 Brain Migration Plan & Rollback Strategy

migration_phases.name: Create Canonical Structure
steps: Create organ directories (context/, memory/, model_mesh/, etc.)
Move promoted src/brain/ modules to canonical locations
Move classified flat_brain/ modules to canonical locations
Update all imports to canonical paths
Update all tests to canonical paths
Update all specs to canonical paths
migration_phases.rollback: If any step fails, revert to flat_brain/ structure via git reset

migration_phases.name: Deprecate flat_brain/
steps: Verify all imports use canonical paths
Verify all specs reference canonical paths
Add deprecation warnings to flat_brain/ imports
migration_phases.rollback: Restore flat_brain/ from git history, re-enable shim

rollback_strategy.safety_net: FlatBrainRedirector shim remains until all imports migrated
